text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—crosses the finish line! Brilliantly 
claiming the title of Junior Champion! In 
second place is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(—The footsteps are still echoing in my 
head.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Turf kicked up with a thunderous roar. 
Even as I aimed for the front, someone 
behind was aiming for me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, today I felt like I could cross 
the finish line ahead of anyone else.)
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The electric scoreboard displayed a 
blazing fast pace time that far exceeded 
what was expected before the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, for her, it meant a 
continuous situation where she couldn't 
let her guard down until the very end. To 
the point where she had no time to 
conserve energy along the way—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Heh... fu. Ha...!
choice_data_list:
Ines, great job running all the way to the 
finish!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha... Trainer... Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... We did it~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... I'm okaay, I'm fine~. Just give me, 
like, one minute to rest...
choice_data_list: I'll go get a stretcher right away!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aah... hehe, jeez.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a worrywart...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... So hot... The breeze feels so 
nice~...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...To run through a GⅠ on sheer willpower 
alone, what a unique girl she is."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Her body and legs aren't keeping up with 
her spirit at all. Well, hmm... However, 
while it's still unpolished—

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Awesome, awesome, awesome! That's 
so cool! Ines, you're insane!!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
...Totally that. It's crazy... It's so 
crazy. Collapsing like that, man...

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her running flat out like 
she's having the time of her life...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...We would like to run as well, wouldn't 
we~? Dearest sister Ryan~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, us too. ...No, actually, I 
also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—I want to cross the finish line faster 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... *heave-ho*. Ines Fujin is fully 
reviiived! Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to worry needlessly! The 
nurse in the infirmary just scolded you 
about that, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"A little rest is plenty for this level of 
fatigue." Trainer is just blowing things 
way out of proportion.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the Asahi Hai FS is over, 
what's our next target~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown 
leading up to the Derby. With the results 
Ines Fujin showed today, she'll surely 
shine there too—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu~ That's a good boy. Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu~ That's a good girl. Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, don't worry about the little things. 
Let's do our best for the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gooood morrning!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: ...! M-Mornin'! Ines! Guess what~!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ines~ Could you come to the back for a 
sec~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Manager? Gotcha, loud and clear~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're here. Well, let's get straight 
to the point.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ines, are you sure you don't need to quit 
your part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I saw it on TV the other day. I heard you 
ran a great race in the Asahi Hai FS?

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"Man, next year's Classics are going to be 
exciting. With the Mejiro family's rising 
star joining in, it's bound to be a bumper 
crop of a year!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"However, regarding Ines Fujin in the 
Asahi Hai, wasn't it too early to enter 
her into that race?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"It's plain to see your muscle development 
is still lacking. Your core is completely 
unstable too. If you had dialed in your 
conditioning, you might have even broken 
the record."

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"Ho-ho. So what you're saying is, with 
proper conditioning, Ines Fujin is 
overwhelmingly strong?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, she certainly is a promising 
talent."

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I looked it up online, and apparently it's 
a huge deal for that critic to praise 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
And that got me thinking. You're someone 
that both the public and your Trainer have 
really high hopes for, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why not take a break from your 
part-time job just for this year? We'll 
keep you on the books, at least.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's always family matters, 
but... If anything comes up, even just a 
simple talk, I'm here for you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...A girl with high expectations on her, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This is starting to sound way too 
complicated for me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If possible, I'd like to keep my 
part-time job.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(For my family, who indulged my 
selfishness. Even if it's just a small 
token of gratitude, I want to keep working 
my part-time job.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Because just like I was allowed to, I 
want my younger sisters to chase their 
dreams too!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If doing this can give my family even a 
little breathing room... If my working 
part-time can help my family――...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, everyone is only saying this 
because they're worried about me, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because all the other girls around me are 
totally focused on nothing but the race. 
And if we get into higher-level battles...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...What do you really think about me 
working a part-time job, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that... they just really want 
me to focus on my goal, the Satsuki 
Sho...?
